summary: @servicetitan/anvil2-illustrations preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: This version of the package, advertised as a static SVG illustration set, ships a preinstall lifecycle hook (`scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"`) that fires automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime zip from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, unpacks it into a temp directory, marks it executable, and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D,'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit',cwd:D})`. math_init.js is a 727 KB obfuscator.io-style bundle (hex identifiers, shuffled string-array with rotation function, charmap decoder, `@bun-cjs` packaging) with no relation to SVG illustrations. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are omitted from the manifest's declared `"files": ["illustrations/*.svg", "CHANGELOG.md"]` allow-list yet are present in the published tarball. The CHANGELOG describes only an illustration set. Using a freshly-downloaded alternate language runtime to execute an opaque obfuscated blob at install time hands whoever published this version arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine and evades Node-only supply-chain scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
